title: Upcoming Features and Roadmap
author: Zach Liibbe
excerpt: A look ahead at what's coming next in the blog system development, including the RAG-powered chat feature.
content:
What's Coming Next?

Now that we have a working blog system, here's what's on the roadmap:

Phase 3: RAG-Powered Chat

  • Pinecone integration: Vector database for knowledge storage
  • Claude API: AI-powered responses about my work and experience
  • Knowledge base: Professional info, projects, and personal details
  • Floating chat widget: Bottom-right corner interface

Additional Improvements

  • RSS feed generation
  • Search functionality
  • Social sharing buttons
  • Reading progress indicator
  • Comment system (future consideration)

This post is scheduled to publish on August 30th at 9 AM UTC.

Cost Optimization

We're keeping costs low by:

  • Using file-based storage instead of a database
  • Implementing conversation limits for the chat system
  • Caching embeddings to avoid re-computation

Excited to continue building in public! 🚀
